name: EMA 20/100 Crossover Strategy — AAPL & MSFT
description: EMA crossover strategy on AAPL and MSFT. Long when 20-day EMA crosses above 100-day EMA, short when it crosses below. 10% of account per trade, both long and short.
source:
# EMA Crossover Strategy - AAPL & MSFT
# 20/100 EMA crossover on daily prices
# Long when 20 EMA crosses above 100 EMA
# Short when 20 EMA crosses below 100 EMA
# 10% of account per trade, long and short

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# --- Signal Logic ---
# Fast (20-day) and Slow (100-day) EMA
fast_ema = ma(period=20, type=MAType.ema)(close)
slow_ema = ma(period=100, type=MAType.ema)(close)

# Trend state: bullish when fast > slow, bearish when fast < slow
is_bullish = fast_ema > slow_ema
is_bearish = fast_ema < slow_ema

# Hold long from bullish crossover until bearish crossover
held_long = hold_until()(enter=is_bullish, exit=is_bearish)

# Hold short from bearish crossover until bullish crossover
held_short = hold_until()(enter=is_bearish, exit=is_bullish)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Fixed 10% of account per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=10)
